Package com.bilt.pos.session

Enum Class SessionErrorCode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SessionErrorCode>
com.bilt.pos.session.SessionErrorCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SessionErrorCode>, java.lang.constant.Constable
public enum SessionErrorCode extends Enum<SessionErrorCode>
High-level error category for a failed session operation.

Derived from the transport outcome and the Nexo Response.ErrorCondition of the terminal reply; the raw condition is preserved on SessionError.getNexoErrorCondition().

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ABORTED
    The operation was aborted (by abort() or the terminal).
    CANCELLED
    The customer cancelled on the terminal.
    DECLINED
    The terminal or acquirer declined the operation.
    INVALID_STATE
    The operation is not valid in the session's current state.
    LOYALTY_UNAVAILABLE
    The loyalty host is unavailable; payment-only retry may succeed.
    NETWORK
    The terminal could not be reached or the connection failed mid-exchange.
    STORED_VALUE_INSUFFICIENT
    The stored value card balance does not cover the requested amount.
    TERMINAL_ERROR
    The terminal reported a device or service error.
    TIMEOUT
    The operation did not complete within the configured timeout.
    UNKNOWN
    The failure could not be classified.
